scope: Named David tomb blocks and immediately attached historic Upper Room exterior group on Mount Zion, using original native footprints. Neighboring Dormition Abbey, other monasteries, cemetery, sculpture and interiors excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with published Qualla originals. Only the unambiguously public-domain1878Bonfils exterior adopted. Modern cleared candidates and postcard depict interiors; unrelated archaeological/map candidates excluded. Native OSM geometry is map data only; image/Mapillary links embedded in native tags are not followed or used as imagery.

originalReview.notes: Full1280x960Bonfils exterior inspected. Original caption explicitly identifies the tomb and Cenacle, published1878in Souvenirs d’Orient; named photographer Félix Bonfils. It shows irregular two-level pale-stone blocks, flat terraces/low domes, a slender roof minaret and arched/paired small openings. Current original native tomb/Cenacle outlines and a mapped roof dome are separate geometric controls. Do not reconstruct neighboring cemetery or every1878wing. Modern public-domain/CC0candidates are interior-only and are excluded from this exterior reference set; postcard is also an interior. Temple Mount/City of David images are unrelated.
